**Observation Log:**

- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For the launch strategy, Ebin New York will provide product images and videos, how-to guides, and clear product descriptions.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] For the promotion strategy, Ebin New York will create social media content, email marketing campaigns, and in-store signage.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The measurement strategy includes tracking sales, social media engagement, and email open and click-through rates.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The strategy plan for measuring an in-store launch campaign includes defining key performance indicators (KPIs) such as sales, foot traffic, and engagement.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The plan includes setting a baseline for sales, foot traffic, and engagement prior to the campaign.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The in-store launch campaign may include in-store signage, product demonstrations, and samples.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] After the campaign, results will be measured and compared to baseline measurements to evaluate effectiveness.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] Adjustments may be made based on the evaluation of the campaign's effectiveness, including adjusting messaging and visuals, offering more demonstrations or samples, and targeting specific customer segments.
